entities.name: Francesco Faà di Bruno

entities.summary: Francesco Faà di Bruno was an Italian priest and advocate of the poor, a leading mathematician of his era and a noted religious musician. In 1988 he was beatified by Pope John Paul II. He is the eponym of Faà di Bruno's formula.
